news.title: If you're in a rush
takeaways: Vulcan certified for NSSL Phase 3 — Space Force gets its second certified heavy lifter.
OSD's 'commercial-first' SDA memo formalised a procurement shift in writing; organic builds now require explicit justification.
Astranis raised $250M strategic; three years on from first GEO-light, the small-GEO thesis is no longer experimental.

funding.title: If you're in a rush
takeaways: $2.7B deployed this week across 8 disclosed rounds — propulsion ate comms's lunch (3 deals vs. 1).
Anduril pulled forward $1.5B pre-IPO; the defense-tech IPO window now depends on their next revenue print.
True Anomaly priced a $190M Series C at $1.6B with DoD pull-through — the co-orbital servicing thesis is investable.

sbir.title: If you're in a rush
takeaways: $26.25M awarded this week across 15 Phase II winners — a 12-month high.
USSF and DARPA dominate (8 of 15 awards); space and AI/ML are the leading sectors.
Lunar logistics shows up twice (Solis Robotics, Plasma Field Systems) — moon procurement is now a real category.

stocks.title: If you're in a rush
takeaways: Defense primes (LMT, NOC, RTX, BA) outperformed pure-plays as space-resilient budget lines firmed up in the FY27 markup.
ASTS bull case is hard to argue against on technology — execution risk is the entire question.
RKLB up on Neutron's 12-second static fire at Wallops; Beck still insists on a first flight 'this year' — the market is ~60% in.

jobs.title: If you're in a rush
takeaways: 15 active roles via EVONA — heavy in Upstream (spacecraft systems, GNC, propulsion) and SATCOM (RF, antenna, network).
Geographic mix is US-led (Long Beach, Reston, Hawthorne, Cape Canaveral) + UK/EU (London, Stevenage, Toulouse) — Europe is hiring.
Several contract roles open (Avionics Test, Constellation Network) — these typically convert to perm within 6 months.

resources.title: If you're in a rush — start here
takeaways: Switching into space? Open 'How to Navigate Career Shifts' and 'Without Aerospace Engineering' first — both are 5–7 minute reads.
Got an interview? 'Top 30 Questions' + 'Phone Interview Tips' cover ~80% of what you'll need.
Need the lay of the land? The 'What Is…' explainers (Satellite, Geospatial Data, Space Engineering) make the rest of the dashboard make sense.
